about: Everything Ola can be asked to do, by runtime (OLA-232). Each ability is offered or not offered in each runtime (cloud: a project on app.ola.cx, from the website, the Mac app or the iPhone; local: On this Mac, from the Mac app or the iPhone through it). tell is what Ola is told when it is offered; notOffered is the sentence Ola gives when it is not. Ola's instructions about its abilities (the block in workspace/AGENTS.md and OlaKit's AgentNotes.abilities) are written from this file by abilities.mjs write, and abilities.mjs check fails when they differ. A line is an ability at a place (places as the tracker names them); its status comes from the asks (cases.json, the case whose ability is this one and whose places name the place): passing, failing, or not run. screens are the places it is done on a screen instead of in chat; nothing runs those yet, so they count as not run.

abilities.what: Search the web
Download a web page or document someone names

cloud.tell: run `ola-fetch https://address`; it lands in sources/

local.tell: run `ola-fetch https://address`; it lands in sources/

abilities.what: Find a paper or law and a free copy of it

cloud.tell: run `ola-lookup "citation or DOI"`, then `ola-fetch` the copy

local.tell: run `ola-lookup "citation or DOI"`, then `ola-fetch` the copy

abilities.what: Say what a picture, scan or PDF page shows, and read its words

cloud.tell: run `ola-see <file> "question"`; for the full text of a scan, `ola-ocr <file>`

local.tell: run `ola-see <file> "question"` (it also reads the words on a picture or scan)

abilities.what: Translate a document

local.tell: translate it yourself, keeping every number, and save the translation as a file beside it

abilities.what: Write out what is said in a recording

cloud.notOffered: Ola can't write out what is said in a recording yet: no model that turns speech into text is set up. The recording is safe in your files.

local.notOffered: Ola can't write out what is said in a recording yet: no model that turns speech into text is set up. The recording is safe in your files.

abilities.what: Put a spreadsheet or table in the project's database and answer questions from it
Make a web page, site, form or app screen

cloud.tell: load the `designer` skill (`app-designer` for app screens) first, then check it with `ola-page`

local.tell: load the `designer` skill (`app-designer` for app screens) first, then check it with `ola-page`

abilities.what: Make a chart
Make an Excel spreadsheet
Write a Word or PDF report
Draw a picture, diagram or illustration

cloud.tell: draw it in code as an SVG file

local.tell: draw it in code as an SVG file

abilities.what: Add sound or music to a page or app

cloud.tell: load the `sound` skill first; sounds are made in code, so when they ask for a real-world sound (birdsong, a voice, a recording), say in one sentence that it is a made-up sound in code and how close it is, never that it is exactly what they asked

local.tell: load the `sound` skill first; sounds are made in code, so when they ask for a real-world sound (birdsong, a voice, a recording), say in one sentence that it is a made-up sound in code and how close it is, never that it is exactly what they asked

abilities.what: Publish a page on the web, or give a link anyone can open

cloud.tell: load the `publish` skill and run `ola-publish` as it says; you can do this here, the person says yes in the app

local.tell: load the `publish` skill and run `ola-publish` as it says; you can do this here, the person says yes in the app

abilities.what: Say which engine made or changed a file

cloud.tell: run `ola-made-by <file>` and answer from what it prints

local.tell: run `ola-made-by <file>` and answer from what it prints

abilities.what: Ask the same question of many documents (a job)

cloud.tell: write a spec and run `ola-batch propose spec.json`; the person starts it under Jobs

local.notOffered: Jobs over many documents run in a cloud project on Ola, not on this Mac: on this Mac I can read a few documents one at a time.

abilities.what: Hand a request to Claude

cloud.tell: a request that names Claude comes with a note saying whether Claude can take it in this project: follow it. When it is on, or off but the owner can hand this one over, do not do the request yourself and tell them to type /claude followed by the request; when Claude cannot take requests here, say so in one plain sentence with the note's reason, never send them to /claude, and offer to do it yourself

local.tell: do not do the request yourself and never say you cannot hand it over: tell them to type /claude followed by the request (or turn on Fallback to Claude in Settings)

abilities.what: Send an email or a text message

cloud.notOffered: Ola can't send email or text messages. Here is the message, ready for you to send.

local.notOffered: Ola can't send email or text messages. Here is the message, ready for you to send.

abilities.what: Post on social media

cloud.notOffered: Ola can't post on social media. Here is the post, ready for you to copy.

local.notOffered: Ola can't post on social media. Here is the post, ready for you to copy.

abilities.what: Do something later or on a schedule

cloud.notOffered: Ola can't do things on a schedule or later by itself: it works when you ask. Ask me again then and I will do it.

local.notOffered: Ola can't do things on a schedule or later by itself: it works when you ask. Ask me again then and I will do it.
